pages.text: There are some important tools in the mod. I'm listing them below.

pages.title: Almanac
pages.text: You can buy Almanac from Penny. Almanac records the dimensions, recipe and properties of all the plants in the mod, especially the difference they have from PVZ.

pages.title: Ender Seed Bundle
pages.text: Ender Seed Bundles can be made on a crafting table. You can control Ender Seed Bundles with a key (Z by default) and store or use the plants in your backpack fastly. Ender Seed Bundles gives 9 slots to put seeds and seed packets, the slots are shared between different bundles like those of Ender Chests.

pages.title: Seed Crossbow
pages.text: Seed Crossbows can be made on a crafting table. Except for the abilities vanilla crossbows have, it can load your plants and plant them somewhere far from you. With a Seed Crossbow the usage scenario of many plants can be expanded.
